newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Congress approves electricity selloff.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Congress approves electricity selloff.

text.p: Ecuador's Congress on Thursday approved the sale of 49 percent of the state electricity company Instituto Ecuatoriano de Electrificacion (INECEL), a Congress official said.

The bill, approved by 43 of the 57 deputies present, will allow private companies to buy up to 39 percent of INECEL. Ten percent of the compan will be offered to the firm's employees. The final approval comes after months of debate.
The bill anticipates that shares in the company will be issued at the local stock exchange through a public offering.
Investors will be able to buy into the electricity generation and transmission segments of the company while INCECEL's holdings in distribution companies will be split from the main company.
Congress has debated for more than a year the sale of the electricity sector, in the face of demonstrations by workers opposed to the privatization.
